title: Intentful 4337 Plug-in
tagline: We integrate the Cow Protocol like Good-after-time order type to the 4337 compliant smart wallet as plug-in, with default MEV rebate functionality enabled by MEV-share

prizes.placement: 🤝 Celo — Best use of Account Abstraction
prizes.title: Celo

description:
We designed an intentful smart order pattern as plug-in to 4337 smart wallet. 

Additionally, we built a simple bundler based on AA-bundler that support MEV rebate functionality leveraging Flashbot's MEV-share. 

With this, we wish to design a novel transactional pattern for the 4337 ecosystem
how_its_made:
We forked SoulWallet's architecture, and built a plugin Good-After-Time contract

We built a simple 4337 bundler based on AA-bundler's implementation with MEV-rebate feature leveraging MEV-share 

Tech used:
- Solidity
- Rust

Open source project used
- Soulwallet
-aa-bundler

With this, we wish to design a novel transactional pattern for the 4337 ecosystem
